description: Variation of condition 1 and 20 of planning permission dated 20th October 2025 (RN:24/08719/FULL) for the Substantial demolition behind retained facade and partial basement retention, erection of new building comprising basement, ground and four upper floors (including a plant enclosure at the roof level) in Class E use with retail fronting New Bond Street and flexible office uses above [RE-CONSULTATION - clarified description of development to emphasise demolition behind retained façade; actual proposals are unchanged.] Namely, deconstruction and Rebuilding of the retained element of the facade, updates to internal floor levels to provide an enhanced retail unit with improved floor to ceiling heights, updates to rear elevation, updates to No.93 New Bond Street fire escape, internal layout updates and roof layout updates.
